steps.text: Agenda cards: three shuffled facedown decks by back, the top card of each faceup beside it
Bounty and Reclaim tokens in shuffled facedown pools; Guilds, Installations, Voidborn Fleet markers, Population dice, Corruption markers, Fleet bases and Fleet Type figures in a common supply
Galactic Board on its competitive or cooperative side
Trade tokens on the six spaces: {s}
Event deck: shuffle each Cycle's Galactic Events, take 2 unseen from each, stack Cycle 1 on top and Cycle 3 at the bottom
Shuffle the Priority cards and reveal {n} in ascending order below the board; deck to their right
Shuffle the Priority cards and deal {n} to each player, kept hidden; box the rest
Solo: remove Priority cards 1, 2, 3, 12, 13 and 14, shuffle and deal yourself 5
Player board, Focus cards, 14 Fleet Power markers and your other markers
Influence dial at {n}; all production and Stockpile dials at zero
Set your Innovation Focus card aside - it is not available in the first Cycle
Solo: swap your Leadership Focus for Unity Focus I; Unity Focus II waits beside the Innovation Focus
Pick a Scenario from the Compendium and build its map: Home sectors nearest each player, then the other sectors and Voidstorm tokens
steps.note: First games: First Spark (competitive) or First Strike (cooperative)

steps.text: Population dice, Corruption tokens, Voidborn fleets, Sector Defences and facedown Bounty and Reclaim tokens on sectors as the Scenario indicates
Technology Tableau: the Scenario's 8 Technologies, each as a stack with the 3-Influence copy on top of the credit-cost copy
Solo Technology Tableau: for 3 random Technologies keep only the credit-cost copy, for the other 5 only the Influence copy
Shuffle the 8 matching Improved Technologies: 4 faceup on the Breakthrough Market, 4 in a facedown deck to their left
Fallen House cards on the sectors the Scenario names, if any; box the rest
Void board where everyone can see it
Crisis deck: {s}, drawn at random by type and shuffled together
steps.note: First game: challenge cards go back in the box. Solo: first remove the general crisis cards marked with the solo icon

steps.text: A Harbinger on the first space of the Economic Threat track and of the Military Threat track
Draw crisis cards until the second space of each Threat track holds one (economic or general; military or general)
Competitive: box the Void board, Crisis cards, Leadership and Unity Focus cards, Joint Focus cards and Harbingers
Each player picks a House from the Scenario: House mat slid into the player board, both Origin cards
steps.note: First play: Valnis, Belitan, Dunlork, Cortozaar

steps.text: Corruption token on the bottommost Agenda slot; Upkeep tracker cubes on 0
Choose one Origin card: its 3-Influence Technology onto your board, the Improved version into your hand
steps.note: 3-4 players: the other basic copy joins the Technology Tableau. 1-2 players: box it

steps.text: Set up your Home sector and Outpost as the Origin card shows: Population die, Fleets, Guilds and Installations
Set production dials, gain the listed resources, Fleet Power markers, track advances and Trade token
steps.note: Don't take extra benefits for these - they are already counted in the Origin card

steps.text: In ascending order of the Origin cards' initial time, each player puts their Turn Order marker above a Priority card
Flip your Origin card to its starting Agenda in the topmost Agenda space; a Trade token gained goes on it
Start Cycle 1 of 3 with the Preparation Phase (its first step is skipped in the first Cycle)
